name: Mostar City Tour – Highlights of the Old Town
tagline: A one-hour guided walk through the historic centre: the clearest introduction to Mostar’s Old Town and its best-known landmarks.
imageAlt: Stari Most and the Old Town of Mostar below Hum hill
level: Easy: uneven cobblestones and some steps
meetingPoint: In front of the Hamam, Old Town
description: This shorter city tour is for visitors who want a clear introduction to Mostar’s Old Town and its most recognisable landmarks. Walk through the historic streets, hear how the town developed and learn about the Old Bridge, the river and the buildings that shaped life in the centre. The guide connects the monuments with local stories and the realities of the city today.

itinerary.text: Meet in front of the Hamam.
Walk through the Old Town towards the Crooked Bridge.
Continue to the Old Bridge, its towers and the local diving tradition.
Finish along Kujundžiluk, the old bazaar street.
Visit the Koski Mehmed Pasha Mosque.

practical: Comfortable shoes: the old cobblestones are uneven and can be slippery.
For the mosque visit, shoulders and knees should be covered.
